item.title: Song Young-gil Declares Candidacy with "Lee Shim Song Shim, Party-Administration Unity" Slogan... Ko Min-jung Joins with "Young Democratic Party" (송영길 “이심송심·당청동색” 출사표…고민정 “젊은 민주당” 가세)
item.description:
Song Young-gil, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, threw his hat into the ring for the party leadership race on August 8, championing the slogan "Lee Shim Song Shim" (meaning Rep. Song Young-gil's will aligns with President Lee Jae-myung's will). Ko Min-jung, a former spokesperson for the Moon Jae-in administration's presidential office, also declared her candidacy for party leader that day, promoting a "young Democratic Party." The party convention will now be a four-way race involving these two, along with former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae. <<> On this day, at the party members' zone in the Democratic Party office in Yeouido, Seoul, Rep. Song stated, "This party convention is not an election to pick who is more distinct, but to choose a representative who will cooperate with the Lee Jae-myung administration to create an irreplaceable Republic of Korea." He added, "I will create a true ruling party that unites tightly and moves as one for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration. The era's task the party should focus on most is turning the Democratic Party into a structurally majority party through the power of 'Lee Shim Song Shim' and 'party-administration unity.'" He criticized former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, saying, "The June 3 election was a defeat wrapped in the guise of victory," and argued, "The president should not have to walk a thorny path alone." This emphasized party-administration alignment, distinguishing himself from former Rep. Jeong. <<> Rep. Song highlighted youth policies, stating, "Without the support of the 2030 generation, there will be no presidential election in 2030," and pledged to appoint two ex-officio supreme council members from the youth, create a 2030 special committee and platform to allow young people direct participation in key party decisions. <<> Rep. Ko, a pro-Moon figure, also held a press conference at the National Assembly's communication hall, challenging the party leadership race by saying, "We need to change the party's signboard. How long will we keep pushing the 86 group to the forefront and only follow them?" She warned, "If we remain mired in power struggles and repeat worthless debates unrelated to people's lives, winning the general election or reclaiming power will become difficult," urging, "We must stop stigmatizing and using derogatory language, acknowledge and communicate with opponents, and seek alternatives." Ko promised measures like youth quota appointments within the party and a youth future committee under the party leader, declaring, "I will forge a path for a young Democratic Party that listens to youth voices externally and nurtures youth internally." <<> With a preliminary primary (cutoff) scheduled for August 21 to narrow down candidates to three, the strategies for each contender are complex. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who declared his candidacy on August 6, and Rep. Song, who is expected to form an "anti-Jeong Cheong-rae alliance," are signaling their intent to "complete the race." <<> Amid all three male candidates—former PM Kim, former Rep. Jeong, and Rep. Song—being considered representatives of the "386 generation," the 40-something female contender Rep. Ko could influence support for former Rep. Jeong. A pro-Moon lawmaker commented, "Rep. Ko may not be representing the pro-Moon group entirely, but some support from traditional voter bases might shift from Jeong to Ko. However, passing the preliminary primary is key." <<> Meanwhile, former PM Kim and former Rep. Jeong continued their verbal sparring over the "self-politics" frame. Appearing on the YouTube show "Kim Eo-joon's Humility is Hard, News Factory," former PM Kim criticized former Rep. Jeong, citing the merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party as an example of "self-politics," saying, "It was a highly volatile issue requiring political judgment, but it was handled with a bombshell declaration, ruining everything." On this day, former PM Kim visited the South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City, touring the Mokpo traditional market and regional committees, followed by a youth forum. Former Rep. Jeong hosted a policy debate at the National Assembly on "Success of the Southwest Semiconductor Cluster," courting support from the Honam region. When asked by reporters about "plans to boost youth support," former Rep. Jeong responded, "The party must embrace and actively resolve the employment and housing issues facing the 2030 generation." <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol: sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Kyung-ju: goh@hani.co.kr (송영길 더불어민주당 의원이 8일 “이심송심”(이재명 대통령의 뜻이 곧 송영길 의원의 뜻)을 내세우며 8·17 전당대회 당대표 출사표를 던졌다. 문재인 정부 청와대 대변인을 지낸 고민정 의원도 “젊은 민주당”을 앞세워 이날 당대표 출마를 선언했다. 민주당 전대는 두 사람과 함께 김민석 전 국무총리, 정청래 전 대표의 4파전 구도로 치러지게 됐다.)

item.title: Korea-Romania Summit… President Lee: "Progress in Defense Cooperation Holds Special Significance" (한-루마니아 정상회담…이 대통령 “방산협력 진전, 특별한 의미”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is visiting Türkiye to attend the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, met with Romanian President Klaus Iohannis on the 8th (local time) to discuss cooperation in the defense industry and other sectors. (북대서양조약기구(나토·NATO) 정상회의 참석을 위해 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 8일(현지시각) 니쿠쇼르 단 루마니아 대통령을 만나 방위산업 분야 등에 대한 협력을 논의했다.)

During the Korea-Romania summit held in Ankara, Türkiye, President Lee stated, "For South Korea, Romania is a truly important cooperation partner," adding, "We are seeing progress in trade as well as in the defense industry, and I believe the local production of the K9 self-propelled howitzer is particularly significant." (이 대통령은 이날 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열린 한-루마니아 정상회담에서 “대한민국에 루마니아는 정말로 중요한 협력 파트너”라며 “교역을 포함해 방위산업 분야에서도 진전이 이뤄지고 있고, 특히 케이(K)9 (자주포)현지생산을 하게 됐다는 점이 특별히 의미가 있다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee emphasized, "In the defense industry, our focus is not just on transactional trade relationships for buying and selling goods, but on achieving substantive cooperation that involves joint development, joint production, and entering third-country markets together." He added, "I hope Mr. President will also visit South Korea to strengthen our practical cooperation." President Lee also joked, "I need to go and experience for myself whether there really is a Dracula," prompting laughter from both leaders. (이 대통령은 “방위산업에 있어서 물건을 사고파는 거래적 관계가 아니라 함께 개발도 하고 공동생산을 하고 제3세계에 함께 진출하는 그런 실질적인 협력이 이뤄진다는 것에 우리는 주안점을 두고 있다”며 “우리 대통령님께서 한국도 방문해주셔서 실질적인 협력을 강화하면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “특히 드라큘라가 있는지 제가 체험하러 가봐야 한다”고 농담을 건네 두 정상이 웃음을 터트리기도 했다.)

In response, President Iohannis said, "Bilateral relations are very good, and we are seeing many interesting investments," noting, "South Korean companies are participating in the refurbishment projects of two nuclear power plants in Romania, and we are also promoting the construction of two new nuclear power plants." He continued, "I think there will be many new opportunities for economic cooperation between our two countries," and expressed, "I sincerely hope the President will visit Romania." (이에 단 대통령은 “양국관계가 매우 좋고, 흥미로운 투자도 많이 이뤄지고 있다”며 “루마니아에 있는 2개 원전에서의 개보수 사업과 관련해 한국 기업들이 참여하고 있고, 2개의 신규원전 건설 사업도 추진하고 있다”고 말했다. 이어 그는 “양국간의 경제 협력에서 새로운 기회들이 여러가지 있을 것 같다”며 “대통령께서 루마니아를 꼭 방문해주길 바란다”고 말했다.)

Ankara/Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (앙카라/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee holds follow-up talks with Trump on ‘warship construction’… Discusses North Korean prisoners with Zelenskyy (이 대통령, 트럼프와 ‘군함 건조’ 후속 협의…젤렌스키와 북한군 포로 논의)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, in his first summit with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the 8th (local time), agreed to resolve the issue of North Korean prisoners of war in Ukraine according to the will of the individuals involved and international law. On the 7th, President Lee met with U.S. President Donald Trump at a dinner hosted by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and his spouse, holding follow-up discussions on the construction of military vessels requested by Trump. (이재명 대통령이 8일(현지시각) 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령과의 첫 정상회담에서 우크라이나 내 북한군 포로 문제를 당사자 자유의사와 국제법에 따라 해결해 나가기로 했다. 이 대통령은 7일에는 레제프 타이이프 에르도안 튀르키예 대통령 내외 주최 만찬에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 만나 그가 요청한 군용 선박 건조와 관련한 후속 협의를 했다.)

President Lee, who is visiting Turkey to attend the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit, held a summit with President Zelenskyy at a hotel in Ankara on this day. Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung reported via a written briefing, “We agreed to resolve the issue of North Korean prisoners of war in Ukraine in a manner that respects the free will of the individuals involved and aligns with international law and humanitarian principles.” Two North Korean soldiers, who were dispatched to Russia and captured by Ukrainian forces, have expressed their desire to go to South Korea. (북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 참석차 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이 대통령은 이날 앙카라의 한 호텔에서 젤렌스키 대통령과 정상회담을 하고 “우크라이나 내 북한군 포로 문제는 당사자들의 자유의사를 존중해 국제법과 인도주의 원칙에 부합하는 방식으로 해결해 나가기로 뜻을 모았다”고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인이 서면 브리핑을 통해 전했다. 러시아에 파병됐다가 우크라이나군에 생포된 북한군 포로 2명은 한국행을 원하고 있다.)

The two leaders also agreed to cooperate on post-war reconstruction projects in Ukraine. Senior Spokesperson Kang stated, “President Lee explained that he announced a comprehensive support commitment of $100 million (approximately 150 billion won) for Ukraine on the occasion of this NATO summit, and emphasized that our government will continue to provide the humanitarian aid needed by the Ukrainian people while also joining international efforts for Ukraine’s recovery and reconstruction.” The previous day, President Lee met with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte and pledged $100 million in support for Ukraine’s reconstruction. A senior official from the presidential office told reporters the day before, “We will exclude lethal weapons and continue support in other areas.” (두 사람은 전후 우크라이나 재건 사업에도 협력하기로 했다. 강 수석대변인은 “이 대통령은 이번 나토 정상회의를 계기로 우크라이나에 대한 1억달러(약 1500억원) 포괄 지원 공약을 발표했음을 설명하고, 우리 정부는 우크라이나 국민들이 필요로 하는 인도적 지원을 지속하면서 우크라이나 복구·재건을 위한 국제사회의 노력에도 지속 동참해 나갈 것이라고 강조했다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 전날 마르크 뤼터 나토 사무총장을 만나 우크라이나 재건을 위해 1억달러 규모의 지원을 약속했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 전날 기자들과 만나 “살상무기는 제외하고 여타 영역에서 지속적인 지원을 해나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang also reported that President Lee met with President Trump the previous day and discussed the construction of military vessels requested by Trump. “President Lee expressed his willingness to cooperate as much as possible with President Trump’s request and introduced our companies with excellent shipbuilding capabilities,” Kang said. “The two leaders agreed to continue working-level consultations to review specific plans.” The two also agreed to arrange President Lee’s visit to the U.S. at an appropriate time, and to play a round of golf on that occasion. (이 대통령은 전날에는 트럼프 대통령과 만나 그가 요청한 군용 선박 건조에 대해서도 논의를 했다고 강 수석대변인이 전했다. 강 수석대변인은 “이 대통령이 트럼프 대통령의 요청에 최대한 협조하겠다면서 우수한 선박 제조 역량을 가진 우리 기업을 소개했다”며 “두 정상은 구체 방안을 검토하기 위한 실무 협의를 이어가기로 했다”고 말했다. 두 사람은 적절한 시기에 이 대통령의 방미를 추진하고, 그 계기에 골프 라운딩도 하기로 했다.)

Meanwhile, in addition to the summit with Ukraine, President Lee held a series of bilateral meetings with leaders of NATO member states, including Norway and Romania, on this day, engaging in ‘defense sales.’ In particular, President Lee agreed with Secretary General Rutte the previous day to begin negotiations for the conclusion of a ‘Korea-NATO Procurement Basic Agreement.’ National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated in a local briefing, “If the agreement is signed, it will lay the groundwork for our companies to participate in the NATO joint procurement market, which is expected to be worth 15 trillion won annually.” (한편 이 대통령은 이날 우크라이나 정상회담 외에도 노르웨이, 루마니아 등 나토 회원국 정상들과도 잇따라 양자 회담을 하며 ‘방산 세일즈’에 나섰다. 특히 이 대통령은 전날 뤼터 사무총장과 ‘한-나토 조달기본협정’ 체결을 위한 협상을 개시하기로 했다. 위성락 국가안보실장은 현지 브리핑에서 “협정이 체결되면 연 15조원으로 예상되는 나토 공동조달 시장에 우리 기업들이 참여할 수 있는 기반이 마련될 것”이라고 말했다.)

Ankara/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (앙카라/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Makes First State Visit to Mongolia in 15 Years… "Seeking Ways to Resume Dialogue with North Korea" (이 대통령, 15년 만에 몽골 국빈 방문… “북한 대화 재개 방안 모색”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung arrived in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia on the 9th (local time), beginning his state visit schedule. (이재명 대통령이 9일(현지시각) 몽골 울란바타르에 도착해 국빈 방문 일정을 시작했다.)

Following the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) summit schedule, President Lee visited Mongolia and is set to hold a summit with President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh, followed by an exchange of agreements and memorandums of understanding (MOUs) and a joint press conference to announce the outcomes of the summit. This marks the first state visit by a South Korean president to Mongolia in 15 years. In the evening, President Lee will attend the "Korea-Mongolia Business Forum," where government and business figures from both countries will discuss mutually beneficial economic cooperation strategies, and deliver a keynote speech. (북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의 일정에 이어 몽골을 방문한 이 대통령은 오흐나 후렐수흐 대통령과 정상회담을 한 뒤 협정·양해각서(MOU) 교환식 및 공동언론발표를 통해 이번 정상회담 성과를 알릴 예정이다. 한국 대통령이 국빈 자격으로 몽골을 방문한 것은 15년 만이다. 이 대통령은 이날 저녁에는 한몽 양국의 정부 및 기업인사가 참여해 양국간 호혜적인 경제 협력 방안을 논의하는 ‘한몽 비즈니스 포럼’에 참석해 기조연설을 한다.)

National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said in a pre-briefing, "Mongolia is a resource-rich country with abundant critical minerals, and since its democratization and transition to a market economy, it has shown great interest in our country's development experience. We have expanded cooperation in various fields such as industrial infrastructure building, transportation and logistics, agriculture, and finance, making it our important economic cooperation partner." (위성락 국가안보실장은 사전브리핑에서 “몽골은 풍부한 핵심광물을 보유한 자원 부국인 동시에 민주화와 시장경제 전환 이후 우리나라의 발전 경험에 높은 관심을 갖고 산업 기반 구축, 교통·물류, 농업, 금융 등 다양한 분야에서 협력을 확대해 온 우리의 중요한 경제 협력 파트너”라고 말했다.)

Furthermore, efforts will be made to build a partnership for realizing peace on the Korean Peninsula. Mongolia, as North Korea's second diplomatic ally after the Soviet Union, maintains traditional friendly relations with North Korea. Director Wi stated, "Through this visit, we aim to discuss measures for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, as well as easing regional tensions and building trust between the two leaders, while seeking feasible ways to resume dialogue with North Korea." (아울러 한반도 평화 실현을 위한 파트너십 구축에도 나선다. 몽골은 소련에 이은 북한의 2번째 수교국으로서 북한과 전통적인 우호 관계를 유지하고 있다. 위 실장은 “이번 방문을 계기로 양국 정상 간에 한반도의 평화와 안정 그리고 역내 긴장 완화와 신뢰 구축 방안을 논의하면서 북한과의 대화를 재개하기 위한 실현 가능한 방안을 모색해 나가고자 한다”고 말했다.)

On the 10th, President Lee will visit the memorial hall for patriot Lee Tae-joon, who provided medical care in Mongolia and supported the independence movement, before holding a luncheon meeting with South Korean residents in Mongolia. On the 11th, he will attend the opening ceremony of Mongolia's largest festival, the "Naadam Festival," as a guest of honor before returning home. The Naadam Festival is a national event celebrating Mongolia's freedom and independence, and this is the first time a South Korean head of state has been invited. (이 대통령은 10일에는 몽골에서 인술을 펼치며 독립운동을 지원한 이태준 열사 기념관을 방문한 뒤 몽골 내 우리 교민들과 오찬 간담회를 진행할 예정이다. 11일에는 몽골 최대축제인 ‘나담축제’ 개막식에 주빈으로 참석한 뒤 귀국한다. 나담축제는 몽골의 자유와 독립을 기리는 국가적인 행사로 우리 정상이 초청된 것은 처음이다.)

Ulaanbaatar/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (울란바타르/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Hey, Jae-myung" Jang Dong-hyuk's Controversy... "No Basic Respect for a President Elected by the People" (“재명아” 장동혁 파문…“국민이 뽑은 대통령에 최소한의 예의도 없어”)
item.description:
On the 7th, Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, who participated in the "polling station blockade protest," held up a sign written in casual Korean saying, "Hey Jae-myung, don't fight with high school students, fight with me." Park Ji-won, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, strongly criticized this, saying, "What kind of behavior is this?" <<> During a plenary session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 8th, Rep. Park asked Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho if he had seen Rep. Jang holding that sign. Minister Jeong replied, "Yes," and added, "Still, as the leader of the largest opposition party, isn't the president someone elected by the people? I think it's a very inappropriate act that shows a loss of basic respect for a leader." <<> Rep. Park continued, "No matter how much harsh language flies around in politics, isn't it a principle to at least maintain decorum toward the head of state and the president? We (the Democratic Party) all referred to Yoon Seok-youl (as 'President Yoon Seok-youl') before he was impeached." <<> He added, "When the leader of the largest opposition party holds up a sign to the incumbent president saying, 'Hey Jae-myung, don't fight with high school students, fight with me,' doing something like that, I think the public authority should also show some sort of stance." <<> In response to Rep. Park's inquiry, Minister Jeong said, "You know well that the Ministry of Justice and the prosecution have very limited authority in such matters. It's a very subjective and insulting remark, but whether it can be charged under criminal law—since the police currently have investigative authority, we'll have to wait for their judgment. In any case, if necessary, the Ministry of Justice will conduct a legal review." <<> Previously, Rep. Jang had often omitted the president's title in official settings since taking office in August last year, drawing criticism from both sides of the aisle. For instance, "Regardless, it's right to show respect befitting the national dignity of the Republic of Korea," said Rep. Seong Il-jong of the People Power Party. <<> Criticism also came from within the People Power Party regarding this "casual-language sign." Yoon Hee-seok, a former spokesperson for the People Power Party and a member of the "pro-Han Dong-hoon faction," assessed the sign as "inappropriate" on MBC Radio's 'Jo Seung-won's News High Kick' that day. He pointed out, "Even just calling (the president) by name is considered a disparaging term. Using disparaging terms mixed in when arguing against a political opponent—no matter how reasonable the argument's content might be—it doesn't get through. Only the disparaging term comes across." <<> Rep. Jang appears unperturbed by the criticism. That evening at the 'Protection of Voting Rights' rally held at Incheon Gurode Square, when a participant on stage shouted, "Since Leader Jang is here, I'll borrow his words to say one thing. Hey Jae-myung, don't fight with high school students, fight with me," Jang smiled and clapped. Kim Min-su, a supreme council member of the People Power Party sitting next to Rep. Jang, burst into a broad smile upon hearing the participant's words, then stood up and waved the Taegeukgi. <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (지난 7일 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’에 나간 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 “재명아, 고등학생 말고 나랑 싸우자”는 내용의 ‘반말 손팻말’을 든 것을 두고 박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 “이따위 짓을 하고 있나”라며 강하게 비판했다.)

item.title: Kim Hyong-o Says, “Jang Dong-hyuk Must Resign and Take Responsibility; Han Dong-hoon Should Give Up Party Leadership Ambitions” (김형오 “장동혁 책임지고 사퇴, 한동훈은 당권 포기해야”)
item.description:
Kim Hyong-o, a former National Assembly speaker and conservative elder who led the first half of the 18th National Assembly, stated that Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, and independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon “should step down. That is the only way for everyone to find a path forward.” The former speaker said that Representative Jang should “resign immediately,” while Representative Han, “regardless of whether he joins the party, should declare that he will not seek party leadership until the next general election.” (18대 국회 전반기 국회의장을 지낸 ‘보수 원로’ 김형오 전 국회의장이 장동혁 국민의힘 대표와 한동훈 무소속 의원을 향해 “내려놓아야 한다. 그래야 모두가 살길이 열린다”고 말했다. 김 전 의장은 장 대표는 “즉각 사퇴”하고 한 의원은 “입당 여부와 별개로 다음 총선 전까지 당권 도전에 나서지 않겠다고 선언해야 한다”고 했다.)

On the 9th, the former speaker posted an article titled ‘Both Jang Dong-hyuk and Han Dong-hoon Must Step Down’ on his blog, saying, “(I am) currently not a member of the People Power Party and have left the party long ago. However, I have not let go of my concern for the values of conservatism that have upheld liberal democracy, nor for the future of the Republic of Korea,” and made these remarks. (김 전 의장은 9일 자신의 블로그에 ‘장동혁도, 한동훈도 내려놓아야 한다’는 제목의 글을 올려 “(나는 현재) 국민의힘 당원이 아니며, 당을 떠난 지 오래된 사람이다. 그러나 자유민주주의를 지켜온 보수의 가치, 대한민국의 미래를 걱정하는 마음까지 떠난 것은 아니다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

The former speaker first pointed out to Representative Jang, “He cannot evade responsibility nor should he avoid it.” He said, “In the Chungcheong region, where Representative Jang invested much effort, we suffered a complete defeat in the elections for regional heads, and the areas he supported collapsed one after another, with few exceptions. Even within and outside the party, people say, ‘Where Jang Dong-hyuk went, they lost; where he didn’t go, they survived.’” He added, “A leader who directed the election and insists on staying in office is not the posture of a politician. I hope he no longer makes himself appear pitiful and diminished.” He further stated, “What Representative Jang should do now is not make excuses or hold on. It is to immediately step down from the leadership and open up space for the party to rebuild.” <<> He also had sharp words for Representative Han. The former speaker wrote, “How would it have been if former leader Han had thrown himself into nationwide support rather than focusing on his own election last time? If he had shown a willingness to humble himself, to sacrifice, and to help fellow candidates survive, even those who disliked him would have seen him differently. But in the end, he came across as someone revealing his political ambitions and became one of the axes of internal party conflict.” He added, “Being smart alone does not make you a great politician. The public looks at sacrifice before ability.” <<> The former speaker continued, “Was it due to the ‘fear of being forgotten’? Or the monopolistic desire that ‘if not me, it can’t work’? This is a common weakness among those who claim to be leaders moving Korea, but it is regrettable. That impatience, the inability to endure even for a moment, lowers the dignity of our politics and prevents us from moving forward.” <<> Concluding his article, the former speaker said, “Both are people capable of great politics. But now, they are gradually making their own vessels smaller. It is time for them to make a decision.” <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (김 전 의장은 먼저 장 대표를 향해 “책임을 면할 수도 없고 피해서도 안 된다”고 지적했다. 김 전 의장은 “장 대표가 공들인 충청권은 광역단체장 선거에서 전패했고, 그가 지원한 지역은 일부를 빼고 줄줄이 무너졌다”며 “당 안팎에서 ‘장동혁이 간 곳은 떨어지고, 가지 않은 곳은 살았다’는 말까지 나왔다”고 했다. 이어 “선거를 지휘한 대표가 자리를 지키겠다는 것은 정치인의 자세가 아니다”며 “더 이상 스스로를 구차하고 초라하게 만들지 말기를 바란다”고 덧붙였다. 또 “장 대표가 지금 해야 할 일은 변명도 버티기도 아니다. 즉각 대표직을 내려놓고 당이 새로 설 공간을 열어주는 일”이라고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea on Strengthened South Korea-Japan Defense Cooperation: “A Reckless Act That Invites Destruction Before a Nuclear Power” (북, 한·일 국방협력 강화에 “핵보유국 눈앞 멸망 불러오는 망동”)
item.description:
North Korea has lashed out at the recent moves for military cooperation between South Korea and Japan, calling them “a foolish reckless act that invites self-destruction, as enemy nations engage in indiscriminate military collusion right before the eyes of a nuclear power.” (북한이 최근 한국과 일본의 군사협력 움직임을 두고 “핵보유국의 눈앞에서 벌리는 적수국들의 무분별한 군사적 결탁놀음은 스스로 멸망을 불러오는 어리석은 망동”이라며 반발했다.)

The Korean Central News Agency reported on the 9th a commentary titled “A Dangerously Perilous Military Collusion That Invites Destruction,” published the previous day (the 8th) by Kang Chol-su, director of the Anti-Enemy Research Institute. The commentary stated that “the military collusion between Japan, a war criminal state racing toward militarization, and South Korea in recent days is becoming increasingly blatant, further endangering the security situation on the Korean Peninsula.” It cited the South Korea-Japan defense ministerial meeting held on the 28th of last month and an incident in January where South Korea’s special flight team, the Black Eagles, received fuel refueling support from the Japan Air Self-Defense Force, claiming that “the security cooperation between Japan and South Korea is steering toward the conclusion of a ‘military logistics support agreement,’ where they would supply each other with military supplies, including ammunition, in times of crisis.” Following the South Korea-Japan defense ministerial meeting on the 28th of last month, the Ministry of National Defense stated, “The government is not currently considering signing a mutual military logistics support agreement.” (조선중앙통신은 대적연구원 실장 강철수가 전날(8일) 발표한 ‘멸망을 자초하는 위험천만한 군사적 결탁’이란 제목의 논평을 9일 보도했다. 논평은 “최근 군사대국화의 길로 질주하는 전범국 일본과 한국 사이의 군사적 결탁이 날로 노골화되어 조선반도의 안보상황을 더욱 위태롭게 만들고 있다”고 했다. 논평은 지난달 28일 열린 한일 국방장관회담과 더불어 지난 1월 한국 특수비행팀 블랙이글스가 일본 항공자위대로부터 연료 급유 지원을 받았던 일 등을 언급하며 “일본과 한국의 안보 협력이 유사시 탄약을 비롯한 군수물자를 서로 제공해주는 ‘군수지원협정’ 체결로 지향되고 있는 것”이라고 주장했다. 지난달 28일 한일 국방장관회담 뒤 국방부는 “정부는 현재 상호군수지원협정 체결을 검토하고 있지 않다”고 밝힌 바 있다.)

The Anti-Enemy Research Institute is a new organization targeting South Korea, believed to be a renamed entity under the former United Front Department’s “National Unification Research Institute.” After North Korea first defined inter-Korean relations as “hostile two-state relations” in 2023, the Anti-Enemy Research Institute began appearing in North Korean media. (대적연구원은 북한의 새로운 대남기구로, 기존 통일전선부 산하 ‘조국통일연구원’이 이름을 바꾼 기관으로 추정된다. 2023년 북한이 처음 남북을 ‘적대적 두 국가’로 규정한 뒤 대적연구원이 북한 매체에 등장하기 시작했다.)

The commentary also claimed that South Korea-Japan security cooperation is “a confrontational alliance targeting our Republic and part of building a ‘triangular nuclear cooperation system’ to militarily check neighboring countries by riding on the U.S. hegemonic strategy.” It further stated that “this is clearly revealed by the fact that Japan and South Korea are unanimously advocating the importance of trilateral cooperation among the U.S., Japan, and South Korea, deploying long-range missiles far beyond their own defense territories, and attempting to possess nuclear-powered submarines.” (논평은 또 한·일 안보협력이 “우리 공화국을 겨냥한 대결공조이며 미국의 패권전략에 편승하여 주변나라들을 군사적으로 견제하기 위한 ‘3각핵 공조체계’ 구축의 일환”이라고 주장했다. 이어 “일본과 한국이 ‘미일한 3자 협력의 중요성’에 대해 입을 모아 제창하고 있으며 자국의 방위 영역을 훨씬 초월하는 장거리 미사일들을 배비(배치)하고 핵동력 잠수함 보유를 시도하고 있는 사실에서도 그대로 드러나고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

The commentary justified the strengthening of nuclear forces, stating, “The reality is that the only way for our Republic to proactively cope with the acute and unpredictably changing international situation and safeguard peace and security on the Korean Peninsula and the region is to continuously expand and strengthen nuclear forces and thoroughly exercise its status as a nuclear weapons state.” It also emphasized, “Whether Japan and South Korea form a military alliance or do anything else, the absolute and unshakable dynamics on the Korean Peninsula built by the strongest nuclear power will absolutely and never change.” (논평은 “현실은 우리 공화국이 핵무력을 지속적으로 확대 강화하고 핵보유국 지위를 철저히 행사하는 것만이 첨예하고 예측불가하게 변화하는 국제정세에 주동적으로 대처하며 조선반도와 지역의 평화와 안전을 수호하는 유일무이한 길”이라며 핵무력 강화를 정당화했다. 아울러 “일한이 군사동맹을 하든 무엇을 하든 최강의 핵보유국이 구축한 조선반도의 절대불퇴한 역학 구도가 바뀌는 일은 절대로, 영원히 없을 것”이라고 강조했다.)

Jang Ye-ji, Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Inside Beijing’s autonomous driving demo zone: vending cars and patrol cars drive themselves (베이징 자율주행 시범구 가보니…자판기차도 순찰차도 자율주행)
item.description:
In Yizhuang, Beijing’s ‘autonomous driving demonstration zone’, unmanned mobile vending vehicles were roaming the streets. These are Level 4 autonomous vehicles—capable of driving, monitoring the environment, and handling emergencies without driver intervention—that move around and sell goods on their own. They were developed by Neolix, a startup that has taken the lead in the autonomous logistics sector, with each unit costing between 20,000 and 30,000 yuan (approximately 4.4 million to 6.7 million won). Customers can purchase items from these vending machines simply by using mobile payments via WeChat Pay or Alipay. A representative from the zone’s innovation operation center said, “Ordinary individuals can buy the vehicle to sell breakfast items or ice cream.” <<> During a visit on the 29th of last month as part of a Korea-China journalist exchange program, the Yizhuang demonstration zone was bustling with not only autonomous unmanned robotaxis and robot buses but also street sweepers and large trucks navigating the streets. Unmanned patrol cars traveled back and forth, surveying the area. This transformation has come from technology accumulated since the demonstration zone was established by the Beijing municipal government in May 2020 to test and commercialize autonomous driving technology. <<> At this site, which aims to fully integrate vehicle, road, and cloud technologies, autonomous vehicles serve as a pillar for people’s mobility, economic activity, and safety. Robotaxi fares are on par with the base fare for regular Chinese taxis, which is around 13 to 15 yuan (approximately 3,000 won), and first-time riders can experience autonomous vehicles for just 1 yuan (about 221 won) by using discount coupons from the innovation operation center. <<> The mini robot bus I boarded that day was a dedicated autonomous vehicle without any driver’s seat or steering wheel, capable of carrying up to eight passengers. It was developed by WeRide, a leading Chinese autonomous driving company. Operating at Level 4 autonomy—driving, monitoring the environment, and handling emergencies without driver intervention—it has been running in the demonstration zone since January 2023, accumulating data needed for commercialization over the past three years. This stands in contrast to Seoul, which announced in January that it would begin a pilot operation of three Level 4 unmanned robotaxis for the first time domestically. In South Korea, services are currently at Level 3 (autonomous driving only on specific sections, with the driver taking control in emergencies) across all national autonomous driving pilot zones. <<> Yizhuang in the Beijing demonstration zone started with an area of 60 square kilometers in 2020 and has now expanded to 600 square kilometers, similar in size to Seoul (approximately 605 square kilometers). It aims to extend to the Sixth Ring Road by the end of 2027. The Sixth Ring Road is an outer ring expressway encircling central Beijing, stretching about 200 kilometers. This massive Chinese autonomous driving laboratory continues to expand. <<> Amid China’s technological rise in various fields, including autonomous driving, artificial intelligence (AI), and robotics, Korean companies are increasingly grappling with the question of how to collaborate with China. <<> At the Yancheng Korea-China Industrial Park in Yancheng City, Jiangsu Province, China, reflections on the direction of Korea-China cooperation were also evident. This industrial park (spanning 50 square kilometers) was officially launched in 2017, following a consensus reached by the two countries during the Korea-China summit in July 2014 to jointly build an industrial park. During a visit there on the 2nd, companies such as Kia Motors, Hyundai Mobis, SK On, and LG Energy Solution were present, with Korean restaurants, signs, and Korean-language road signs lining the city streets. Inside the Kia Motors plant, robotic arms moved nonstop across the factory floor. <<> Kia Motors had established and operated its first overseas factory in the Yancheng Industrial Park since 2004, even before the park was formed. Lee Hwa-su, a manager at Kia’s plant, said, “(To date) we’ve produced 33 models and a cumulative total of 6.9 million vehicles.” He added, “Kia’s Chinese factory directly employs about 4,000 people, and its approximately 190 dealerships employ between 6,000 and 10,000 people. Including 238 partner companies, it’s estimated to have created around 100,000 jobs.” The steel panels needed at the plant are all supplied by Hyundai Steel, and among the 238 partner companies, 91 have accompanied the company from Korea. <<> However, as Chinese automakers rapidly enhance their technology and price competitiveness, and the adoption of electric vehicles increases, Kia—focused on internal combustion engines—is finding its position shrinking. Currently operating Plants 2 and 3, which have a maximum capacity of 750,000 units, the company is producing just over 200,000 units. In 2016, it showed its strength by producing up to 650,000 units, but was hit hard by the THAAD (Terminal High Altitude Area Defense) incident, closed Plant 1 in 2019, and turned it over to the joint venture partner, Yue Da Group, on a long-term lease. When Plant 1 was still running, Kia could produce up to 1.05 million units, but production plummeted to 150,000 units during the pandemic. <<> Ultimately, Kia changed its strategy starting in 2024 to focus on export markets rather than domestic sales in China. It increased its export models from just two to six and decided to export 80% of its total production. As a result, it sold 240,000 units in 2024, surpassing the break-even point of 230,000 units, and achieved a return to profitability. Last year, sales increased slightly to 250,000 units, and this year, the company has a sales target of 270,000 units. Manager Lee Hwa-su stated, “Currently, we have three models dedicated to the Chinese market and seven global models for export.” <<> This can be seen as a last-ditch strategy adopted when unable to overcome the competitiveness of Chinese firms. Kia’s shift in strategy leaves a challenge not only for the Korean automotive industry, which has lost influence in China’s auto ecosystem, but also regarding how to restructure industrial collaboration with China, which is strengthening its technological rise. <<> Beijing/Yancheng | Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (중국 베이징의 ‘자율주행 시범구’ 이좡에는 무인 이동식 자판기 차량이 달리고 있었다. 운전자 개입 없이 차량 스스로 주행과 환경 감시, 비상 대처 등을 하는 레벨4 수준 자율주행 차량으로, 스스로 옮겨다니며 물건을 판다. 자율주행 물류 분야를 선점한 스타트업 네오릭스가 만들었는데, 대당 가격이 2만∼3만엔(약 440만원∼670만원) 수준이다. 위챗페이나 알리페이로 모바일 결제만 하면 자판기 물건을 살 수 있다. 시범구 혁신운영센터 관계자는 “일반 개인이 (차량을) 구매해 아침 식사용 음식을 팔거나, 아이스크림 등을 팔 수도 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Lee Jin-sook again asks, "What does Starbucks have to do with the May 18 Democratic Uprising?"—Has she not seen Baejae High School's apology? (이진숙 또 “스벅과 5·18 무슨 관계냐”…배재고 사과 못 봤나)
item.description:
Amidst the controversy where the baseball team of Seoul's Baejae High School, which sang a 'Starbucks cheer song' mocking the May 18 Democratic Uprising, apologized to Gwangju Jeil High School (Gwangjuil High School), and Gwangjuil High School requested leniency for Baejae High School which faced severe disciplinary action, Lee Jin-sook, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, has continued to resist, repeatedly asking, "What does Starbucks have to do with the May 18 Uprising?" <<> Appearing on MBN's 'News Wide' on the 8th, the lawmaker stated, "A clear conclusion hasn't been reached on whether 'Starbucks is a term that insults the May 18 Uprising.' If that's the case, when the Baejae High School baseball team used the term Starbucks in a cheer song and said, 'Let's go to Starbucks,' how is that an act of insulting the May 18 Uprising? This is by no means a concluded matter." The lawmaker had previously sparked controversy on the 5th by reportedly sending a congratulatory wreath to Baejae High School with the message, "What does Starbucks have to do with the May 18 Uprising?" and has not wavered in her stance. <<> The lawmaker argued, "The moment May 18 becomes a sanctuary, many things become taboo," adding, "The more a society has sanctuaries and taboos, the more it becomes a dictatorship." <<> She continued, "If May 18 becomes a sanctuary, many people have to endure taboos; they shouldn't talk about Starbucks, shouldn't say 'Let's go to Starbucks.' How can this be a free democratic country?" <<> This incident erupted last month on the 29th during the 81st Cheongnyonggi National High School Baseball Tournament, when some players from Baejae High School's baseball team shouted the slogan "Let's go to Starbucks" at opposing players from Gwangjuil High School. Some students also loudly shouted "Tank Day." This slogan was perceived as a 'mocking cheer,' recalling an incident where Starbucks Korea recently caused controversy with a marketing promotion called 'Tank Day' around the anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising. On the 1st, the Korea Baseball Softball Association (KBSA) imposed a six-month ban from national tournaments on Baejae High School's baseball team, and on the 6th, Baejae High School players visited Gwangjuil High School to apologize. In response, the following day, Gwangjuil High School requested leniency for Baejae High School, and on the 8th, Baejae High School filed an appeal for a retrial with the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee. <<> After the lawmaker announced sending the wreath, criticism followed from political circles and civil society. Park Kyung-mi, spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 6th, "The students apologized maturely, but the lawmaker sent an immature wreath." Hong Seong-gyu, spokesperson for the Progressive Party, also stated on the 7th, "All forms of supporting, inciting, and instigating hate crimes must be eradicated immediately from the political sphere. The lawmaker's truly deplorable and infuriating 'congratulatory wreath for Baejae High School' is a prime example." <<> Kim Young-jin, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party, appeared on KBC Gwangju Broadcasting on the 7th and said, "I believe that people like lawmaker Lee, who try to gain political advantage by riding on the coattails of wrong derogatory terms, insults, and attacks on the May 18 Uprising, are the worst in our society." <<> Lawmaker Kim criticized, "That person rode on that wave, stoking conflict to gain political benefit and raise their profile," adding, "Truly despicable." He continued, "That person should face public judgment and evaluation and be expelled from politics," arguing, "It is not at all appropriate for them to serve as a lawmaker representing the people." <<> Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (5·18 민주화운동을 조롱하는 ‘스타벅스 응원가’를 부른 서울 배재고 야구부가 광주제일고(광주일고)에 사과하고 광주일고는 중징계를 받은 배재고에 대한 선처를 요청한 가운데, 이진숙 국민의힘 의원이 거듭 “스타벅스와 5·18이 무슨 관계냐”며 반발을 이어갔다.)

item.title: Hong Myung-bo, Chung Mong-gyu, Park Ji-sung, Son Heung-min as Witnesses and Referents... National Assembly Holds KFA Hearing on the 22nd (홍명보·정몽규·박지성·손흥민 증·참고인…국회 22일 축협 청문회)
item.description:
The National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee has decided to hold a hearing on the Korea Football Association at 10 a.m. on the 22nd. Witnesses include former national football team head coach Hong Myung-bo and former KFA President Chung Mong-gyu, while referents include Park Ji-sung, co-chair of the K-Football Innovation Committee, and national football player Son Heung-min (LAFC). (국회 문화체육관광위원회가 오는 22일 오전 10시 대한축구협회에 대한 청문회를 진행하기로 했다. 증인에는 홍명보 전 축구 국가대표팀 감독, 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장 등이, 참고인에는 박지성 케이(K)-축구 혁신위원회 공동위원장과 국가대표 축구선수 손흥민(LAFC) 등이 이름을 올렸다.)

The Committee held a plenary session that day and adopted a plan to hold a hearing on pending issues related to the Korea Football Association, led by the Democratic Party of Korea. Lawmakers from the People Power Party did not enter the meeting, protesting the Democratic Party-led formation of the standing committee for the second half of the 22nd National Assembly. (문체위는 이날 전체회의를 열어 대한축구협회 현안 관련 청문회 실시계획서를 더불어민주당 주도로 채택했다. 국민의힘 의원들은 민주당 주도의 22대 국회 후반기 상임위원회 원 구성에 항의하며 회의에 들어오지 않았다.)

A total of 23 witnesses and referents were adopted for the hearing at the Committee that day. Alongside former coach Hong and former president Chung, 13 witnesses were listed, including former KFA Technical Director Lee Im-saeng, who played a leading role in appointing former coach Hong, former National Team Strengthening Committee Chairman Jeong Hae-seong, KFA Vice President Kim Byung-ji, and former KFA Vice Presidents Park Hang-seo and Han Jun-hee. Referents totaled 10, including K-Football Innovation Committee Co-Chairs Park Ji-sung and Yoo Seung-min, Innovation Committee members Lee Young-pyo and Park Joo-ho, MBC football commentator Seo Hyung-wook, former national player Kim Young-kwang, and national team players Son Heung-min and Hwang Hee-chan. (이날 문체위에서 채택된 청문회 증인·참고인은 모두 23명이다. 증인에는 홍 전 감독과 정 전 회장 외에도 홍 전 감독 선임 당시 주도적 역할을 했던 이임생 전 축구협회 기술총괄이사, 그리고 정해성 전 국가대표 전력강화위원장, 김병지 대한축구협회 부회장, 박항서·한준희 전 대한축구협회 부회장 등 모두 13명이 이름을 올렸다. 참고인에는 박지성·유승민 케이-축구 혁신위 공동위원장, 이영표·박주호 케이-축구 혁신위원, 서형욱 문화방송(MBC) 축구 해설위원, 김영광 전 국가대표 축구선수, 그리고 국가대표 축구선수 손흥민·황희찬 등 모두 10명이 이름을 올렸다.)

Committee Chair Lee Jae-jung, a member of the Democratic Party, stated, "This hearing is intended to examine, at the National Assembly level, various issues that have arisen in the process of appointing the national football team coach and the overall management of the KFA, and to seek measures to normalize the KFA." He added, "While we respect the autonomy and expertise of the KFA, we could not neglect the role of the National Assembly, given the public nature of football." (민주당 소속의 이재정 문체위원장은 “(이번 청문회는) 축구 국가대표팀 감독 선임 절차와 대한축구협회 운영 실태 전반에 나타난 여러 문제점에 대해 국회 차원에서 현안을 점검하고 대한축구협회의 정상화 방안을 모색하기 위한 것”이라며 “대한축구협회의 자율성과 전문성은 존중하되, 축구가 가지는 공공성에 착안해 국회의 역할을 뒤로 무를 수 없었다”고 말했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Jo Gye-won expressed, "I cannot help but have deep concerns about whether this hearing will be properly conducted. This is because key parties to the case, such as former President Chung, former Coach Hong, and former Director Lee, have resigned one after another and fled abroad, showing a high likelihood of evading the National Assembly's summons." He continued, "Even though our office has requested dozens of documents to uncover the truth of this incident, the KFA has held out and not submitted a single document so far. This is an act of disregarding the National Assembly," urging the key figures to attend the hearing and faithfully submit materials. (조계원 민주당 의원은 “이번 청문회가 제대로 치러질 수 있을지 깊은 우려를 금할 수 없다. 정 전 회장, 홍 전 감독, 이 전 이사 등 사건의 핵심 당사자들이 줄줄이 사임하고 외국으로 도피하는 등의 행보를 보이며, 국회 출석 요구에 회피할 가능성이 매우 커 보이기 때문”이라며 “심지어 저희 의원실에서 이번 사태의 진상을 규명하기 위해 수십 건의 자료 제출을 요구했음에도 불구하고, 축구협회는 지금까지 단 한 건의 자료도 제출하지 않고 버티고 있다. 이는 국회를 무시하는 처사”라고 말하고, 주요 인물들의 청문회 출석과 성실한 자료 제출을 촉구했다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk, 'Jang Yoon-gi Case' Gwangju Police Chief Meeting Falls Through... "Is This How You Treat the Public?" (장동혁, ‘장윤기 사건’ 광주경찰청장 면담 불발…“이게 국민 대하는 태도”)
item.description:
People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk and other leaders visited the Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency on the 9th to protest over suspicions of poor investigation and collusion in the 'Gwangju High School Student Murder Case,' but the meeting with Police Chief Kim Young-geun was canceled because he was out of the office. Representative Jang said, "Is this how the South Korean police treat the public?" and added, "When the police hold all investigative powers without supplementary investigative authority, the damage will fall entirely on the people." (장동혁 대표 등 국민의힘 지도부가 9일 ‘광주 고등학생 살인사건’ 부실 수사·수사 유착 의혹과 관련해 광주경찰청을 항의 방문했으나 김영근 광주경찰청장이 외부에 있다는 이유로 면담이 불발됐다. 장 대표는 “이게 대한민국 경찰이 국민을 대하는 태도”라며 “경찰이 보완수사권도 없이 수사권 전부를 가졌을 때 그 피해는 오롯이 국민들께 돌아갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Representative Jang, along with lawmakers Shin Dong-wook, Kim Jang-gyeom, Seo Cheon-ho, and Park Jun-tae, visited the Gwangju Police Agency building that afternoon to meet Chief Kim, but were blocked in the lobby by police. Representative Jang canceled a previously scheduled meeting with Prime Minister Han Deok-soo to come to Gwangju. (장 대표를 비롯해 신동욱·김장겸·서천호·박준태 의원은 이날 오후 김 청장을 만나기 위해 광주경찰청 청사를 방문했으나 로비에서 경찰에 가로막혔다. 장 대표는 이날 예정됐던 한성숙 국무총리와의 회동을 취소하고 광주를 찾았다.)

Officials at the Gwangju Police Agency in the lobby gave no explanation beyond saying, "It's for security reasons." The lawmakers protested, "Won't you even guide us to a meeting room?" "This is the rightful duty of members of the National Assembly, a constitutional body. Where in the world does law allow you to block us from entering the lobby because the chief isn't here?" "How can you become a high-ranking public official if you can't even answer a question?" (로비에 있던 광주경찰청 관계자들은 “보안 때문”이라는 말 외에 별다른 설명을 하지 않았다. 의원들은 “회의실조차 안내를 안 한다는 거냐”, “헌법기관인 국회의원들의 당연한 책무다. 청장이 없다고 로비에서 들어가지 못하는 게 어느 나라 법이냐”, “질문에 답변도 못 하면서 어떻게 고위공직자가 됐냐”고 항의했다.)

Representative Jang said, "The lack of will and heart to protect the lives and safety of the people, and this attitude toward the public, have led to crimes like these. And this attitude has manifested in the shameless act of covering up evidence, scaling down investigations, and trying to bury the case as if it's their own family." (장 대표는 “국민의 생명과 안전을 지킬 의지도 마음도 없는 모습, 국민을 이렇게 대하는 모습이 이런 범죄를 발생하게 했다. 그리고 이런 모습이 떳떳하게 부끄럼 하나 없이 자기 식구라고 증거 인멸하고 수사 축소하고 사건 은폐하려 한 그 모습으로 발현된 것”이라고 말했다.)

After about 30 minutes of confrontation with police in the agency lobby, the People Power Party leadership eventually turned away. Targeting the Democratic Party of Korea, which is pushing to abolish supplementary investigative authority, Representative Jang said, "Even under the prosecution's control, the police have been hiding and manipulating cases and committing crimes brazenly. Now, you want to let the police wield absolute power without any direction or oversight." (30분가량 청사 로비에서 경찰과 대치한 국민의힘 지도부는 결국 발길을 돌렸다. 장 대표는 보완수사권 폐지를 추진하는 더불어민주당을 겨냥해 “(경찰이) 검찰의 통제를 받아도 이렇게 사건을 은폐·조작하고 당당하게 범죄행위를 저지르고 있는데, 이제 어떤 지휘도 통제도 없이 경찰이 무소불위의 권력을 행사하게 만들겠단 것”이라고 말했다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea plans to finalize and propose an amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act later that day, based on abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigative authority while actualizing the right to demand supplementary investigations, through the final meeting of its Criminal Procedure Act Amendment Task Force. (더불어민주당은 이날 오후 당 형사소송법 개정 티에프(TF) 최종 회의를 통해 검찰의 보완수사권을 폐지하되 보완수사요구권을 실질화하는 내용을 뼈대로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 확정해 발의할 예정이다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Adds One Ethics Committee Member… Pushing Forward with ‘Jang Dong-hyuk Discipline Situation’ (국힘, 윤리위원 1명 추가…‘장동혁 징계 정국’ 속도 내나)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) signaled a ‘disciplinary situation’ on the 9th by additionally appointing one member to its Central Ethics Committee. (국민의힘이 9일 당 중앙윤리위원회 위원 1명을 추가로 임명하면서 ‘징계 정국’을 예고했다.)

The PPP’s Supreme Council voted on and passed an agenda to appoint one additional Central Ethics Committee member at a meeting held that morning at the National Assembly. This increases the number of ethics committee members from the previous six to seven, including Ethics Committee Chair Yoon Min-woo. According to the party’s constitution and regulations, the ethics committee can have up to nine members. The newly appointed member is reportedly a current practicing lawyer. At the closed meeting that day, only Woo Jae-jun, the youth supreme council member, expressed concerns regarding the additional ethics committee appointment. (국민의힘 최고위원회는 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 회의에서 중앙윤리위원 1명을 추가 임명하는 안건을 상정·의결했다. 이에 따라 윤민우 윤리위원장을 포함해 기존 6명이었던 윤리위원 수는 7명으로 늘어났다. 당헌·당규상 당 윤리위는 9명 이내로 구성할 수 있다. 추가 임명된 위원은 현직 변호사인 것으로 알려졌다. 이날 비공개회의에서는 우재준 청년 최고위원만 윤리위원 추가 임명과 관련해 우려한 것으로 전해졌다.)

The additional appointment of an ethics committee member came amid a phase where, after recent party leader Jang Dong-hyuk expressed his will to ‘strengthen party discipline,’ the ethics committee began reviewing disciplinary motions. Earlier, the party’s ethics committee held its first meeting since the local elections on the 6th to review disciplinary motions, but reportedly did not decide whether to initiate disciplinary action. The cases involve pro-Han (pro-Han Dong-hoon) lawmakers who assisted independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon in the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, as well as members of the Alternatives and Future group who publicly called for Party Leader Jang’s resignation. Chief Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting, “Disciplinary reviews by the ethics committee had been paused before the local elections, and holding ethics committee meetings after the local elections, in accordance with party members’ demands and the party’s constitution and regulations, is a natural and necessary procedure.” (윤리위원 추가 임명은 최근 장동혁 대표가 ‘당 기강 확립’ 의지를 밝힌 뒤 윤리위원회가 징계안 심의에 돌입한 국면에서 이뤄졌다. 앞서 당 윤리위는 지난 6일 지방선거 이후 첫 회의를 열고 징계안을 심의했지만 징계 개시 여부를 결정하지 않은 것으로 전해졌다. 부산 북갑 보궐선거에서 한동훈 무소속 의원을 도운 친한(친한동훈)계 의원들과 장 대표의 사퇴를 공개적으로 요구했던 대안과미래 소속 의원 등이 제소된 상황이다. 최보윤 수석대변인은 최고위 직후 기자들과 만나 “지방선거 이전에 윤리위 징계(심의)가 멈춰 있었고, 당원들의 요구나 당헌·당규에 따라 윤리위가 지선 이후 열리는 건 자연스럽고 필요한 절차”라고 말했다.)

The PPP also reinforced its spokesperson team on the same day. Ham In-kyung, whose term as spokesperson had expired, and Media Spokesperson Lee Ji-ae were reappointed, while Bong Seong-beom, who served as Incheon City’s citizen communication officer, was newly appointed as a media spokesperson. Spokesperson Lee had previously faced criticism as a ‘Yoon Again’ figure for her remark, “Thank you to you (former President Yoon) for waking us up from our slumber.” (국민의힘이 이날 대변인단도 일부 보강했다. 임기가 만료된 함인경 대변인과 이지애 미디어대변인을 유임하고 인천시 시민소통담당관 등을 지낸 봉성범 미디어대변인을 새로 임명했다. 이 대변인은 “우리를 잠에서 깨워준 당신(윤 전 대통령)께 감사드린다”는 발언으로 ‘윤 어게인’ 인사라는 비판을 받은 바 있다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Election Commission Chair to Become Full-Time Position, Secretary General to Face Confirmation Hearing… Democratic Party Proposes ‘Three Bills on NEC Reform’ (중앙선관위원장 상근직, 사무총장 인사청문…민주 ‘선관위 3법’ 발의)
item.description:
On the 9th, the Democratic Party of Korea proposed the ‘Three Bills on National Election Commission (NEC) Reform’, which include changing the chair of the National Election Commission to a full-time position and requiring a parliamentary confirmation hearing for the appointment of the Secretary General. Separately, the Democratic Party also proposed a special counsel bill for the NEC on the same day, allowing a third party, rather than the ruling and opposition parties, to recommend the special counsel. <<> The Democratic Party’s ‘TF for Institutional Reform to Protect Citizens’ Political Rights’ announced at a press conference at the National Assembly that it has prepared the three reform bills (amendments to the NEC Act, the National Assembly Act, and the Personnel Confirmation Hearing Act) “to proactively respond to the infringement of citizens’ political rights.” <<> In the amendment to the NEC Act, the Democratic Party included provisions to change the current part-time chair of the National Election Commission to a full-time position. Lawmaker Lee Hae-sik stated, “We will improve the part-time system, which has been criticized as being merely a rubber stamp, to handle key NEC affairs on a decision-oriented basis rather than a reporting-oriented one, and to establish a system for effectively managing and supervising the secretariat.” The number of standing commissioners at the NEC will also be increased from the current one to three. Additionally, the bill includes measures to establish an audit committee composed entirely of external members to prevent the possibility of inadequate audits. <<> The Democratic Party included in the amendments to the National Assembly Act and the Personnel Confirmation Hearing Act provisions for appointing the Secretary General of the National Election Commission from external candidates and requiring the candidate for Secretary General to undergo a parliamentary confirmation hearing. The TF stated, “We will formulate and report a constitutional amendment proposal after the constitutional amendment direction forum scheduled for the 20th and the 8th TF meeting,” adding, “We will review additional legislation if necessary through extensive opinion gathering.” <<> On the same day, the Democratic Party also proposed a special counsel bill to investigate the truth behind the shortage of ballot papers for the June 3 local elections and to punish those responsible. <<> The special counsel candidate is to be recommended by a third party, not by political parties. The People Power Party has proposed a special counsel bill that allows them to recommend two candidates alone. Cheon Jun-ho, Deputy Chief of the Democratic Party’s Leadership for Legislative Affairs, said at a policy coordination meeting, “The core of the NEC special counsel is fairness,” and explained, “Typically, the ruling party, the opposition party, and the Korean Bar Association each recommend candidates, and the president appoints one of them. However, since this involves an investigation into election management, we can agree to exclude party recommendations. I ask the People Power Party to cooperate as well.” <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당이 9일 중앙선거관리위원회 위원장을 상근직으로 바꾸고, 사무총장 임명 땐 국회 인사청문회를 거치도록 하는 내용 등이 담긴 ‘선관위 개혁 3법’을 발의했다. 이와 별개로 민주당은 이날 여야가 아닌 제3자가 특검을 추천하도록 한 선관위 특별검사법도 발의했다.)

item.title: Conservative Opposition Rekindles 'Desertion Suspicion' Against Ahn Kyu-baek... Ministry of National Defense: "Already Clarified a Year Ago" (보수 야권, 안규백 ‘탈영 의혹’ 재점화…국방부 “1년 전 이미 소명”)
item.description:
The conservative opposition, including the People Power Party, has reignited suspicions that Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek deserted his post (went AWOL) during his short-term military service (as a reserve soldier) and demanded on the 9th that his military records be made public. The Ministry of National Defense maintains that the suspicion was already resolved during the personnel hearing in July of last year. (국민의힘을 비롯한 보수 야권이 안규백 국방부 장관의 단기사병(방위병) 시절 군무이탈(탈영) 의혹을 재점화하며 9일 병적기록을 공개하라고 요구했다. 국방부는 해당 의혹이 지난해 7월 인사청문회에서 이미 소명이 됐다는 입장이다.)

People Power Party floor leader Chung Jin-seok posted on Facebook that day, stating, "There are suspicions that Minister Ahn Kyu-baek illegally deserted his military duties for about seven months while serving as a reserve soldier in 1983, was arrested, and was detained in the guardhouse for 30 days." He asked, "Can someone with the stigma of being a 'deserter who was in the guardhouse' command 450,000 military personnel?" He called on Minister Ahn to "immediately and transparently disclose all related materials." Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon also met with reporters at the National Assembly that day and said, "While the Minister of National Defense of South Korea, which faces North Korea, could be a former reserve soldier, he should not be a former reserve soldier who deserted, and why isn't he explaining himself? If he feels wronged, let him sue me. I have no intention of using my immunity." <<> In response, Ministry of National Defense spokesperson Jung Bit-na stated in a regular briefing that day, "Regarding the raised suspicions, the Minister of National Defense maintains the same position as during the personnel hearing a year ago, that he completed his service normally." <<> Meanwhile, the police launched an investigation into the suspicions on the same day. The Yongsan Police Station in Seoul plans to summon Kim Young-soo, director of the Defense Rights Research Institute, on the 16th to conduct an investigation into the complainant regarding suspicions of false testimony by Minister Ahn at the National Assembly. Kim filed a complaint against Minister Ahn on the 27th of last month, alleging that Ahn's response during the personnel hearing—that there were no instances of desertion or detention—constituted perjury, thus violating the Act on Testimony and Appraisal before the National Assembly. <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hae-young hycho@hani.co.kr (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “안규백 장관은 1983년 방위병 복무 시절, 약 7개월간 위법적으로 군무를 이탈했다가 체포되어 30일간 영창에 구금되었다는 의혹이 있다”며 “‘영창 다녀온 탈영병’이라는 의혹을 달고 45만 군 장병을 지휘할 수 있겠느냐”고 밝혔다. 그는 안 장관을 향해 “즉시 모든 관련 자료를 투명하게 공개하라”고 했다. 한동훈 무소속 의원도 이날 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “북한과 대치하는 대한민국 국방부 장관이 방위 출신일 수는 있지만, 탈영한 방위 출신이면 안 된다”며 “왜 해명을 안 하나. 억울하면 저를 고소하라. 저는 면책특권을 쓸 생각이 없다”고 말했다.)

item.title: '36-year-old Ordinary Member' Kim Bo-mi Challenges for Democratic Party Leadership... "I Will Bring the Youth Back" (‘36살 평당원’ 김보미, 민주 당대표 도전…“청년 돌아오게 하겠다”)
item.description:
Kim Bo-mi (36), a former chairperson of the Jeonnam Gangjin County Council and an ordinary member of the Democratic Party of Korea, has thrown her hat into the ring for the party's leadership election. (더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 평당원인 김보미(36) 전 전남 강진군의회 의장이 출사표를 던졌다.)

At a press conference held on the 9th at the party members' zone of the Democratic Party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, the former chairperson Kim stated, "The Democratic Party, having lost fairness, has lost its youth, and a Democratic Party without youth has no future. I will make the young people who left the Democratic Party come back," officially announcing her candidacy. She added, "Even after graduating and building up their resumes, young people cannot find jobs, and even if they run from dawn, all that remains in their bank accounts are loan interest and credit card bills," and "Instead of branding them as Ilbe, conservative, or far-right, taking care of the lives of the youth is the responsibility of the ruling Democratic Party." <<> The former chairperson Kim remarked, "The '386 generation' who were young once created democracy in South Korea, and I deeply appreciate that history, but now the '686 generation' are merely the establishment, just old-timers thoroughly imbued with the belief that it's 'me or no one else,'" and "I will transform the Democratic Party not into a party for a specific generation, but for all generations." She also said, "I will propose a growth strategy that establishes the regions as the engine of success for South Korea and the Lee Jae-myung government, creating a Democratic Party that the youth love." <<> The former chairperson Kim joined the Democratic Party in 2013 and served as a two-term county councilor in Gangjin, Jeonnam, and as the youngest-ever chairperson of a basic council in the nation. <<> Correspondent Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (김 전 의장은 9일 서울 여의도 민주당 중앙당사 당원존에서 기자회견을 열고 “공정을 잃은 민주당은 청년을 잃었고, 청년을 잃은 민주당에는 미래가 없다. 민주당을 떠난 청년들이 다시 돌아오게 하겠다”며 공식 출마선언을 했다. 그는 “청년들은 졸업하고 스펙을 쌓아도 직장을 구할 수 없고, 새벽부터 뛰어도 통장에 남는 것은 대출 이자와 카드값 뿐”이라며 “일베니, 보수니, 극우니 낙인찍지 말고, 청년을 삶을 돌보는 게 집권여당 민주당의 책임”이라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Revives Youth Supreme Council Position After 8 Years… Government Also Pushes Youth Policies (민주, 8년 만에 청년최고위원직 부활…정부도 ‘청년 정책’ 힘쏟기)
item.description:
The Blue House and the ruling party are focusing on youth policies ahead of the June 3 local elections. Perceiving the conservative shift among the younger generation as stemming from the structural issue of "deprivation of opportunity," they are accelerating efforts to devise countermeasures. (청와대와 여당은 6·3 지방선거를 계기로 청년 정책에 공을 들이고 있다. 청년 세대의 보수화 흐름이 ‘기회의 박탈’이란 구조적 문제에서 기인한 것으로 보고 대책 마련에 속도를 내는 모습이다.)

President Lee Jae-myung’s remarks at a cabinet meeting on the 23rd of last month, where he said, "Young people who lack opportunities to build assets through stable jobs and income are the most marginalized in our time," reflect this context. He added, "The government must painfully acknowledge the sense of alienation felt by those for whom record bonuses or the KOSPI seem like stories from another world," emphasizing that "consistent and meticulous efforts to give more opportunities to young people across all policies are important." This was a call to address the serious disaffection among the younger generation. (지난달 23일 이재명 대통령이 국무회의에서 “안정적 일자리와 소득을 통해 자산을 형성할 기회 자체가 부족한 청년은 현시대의 가장 큰 소외자들”이라고 말한 것도 이런 맥락이다. 이 대통령은 이어 “역대급 성과급이나 코스피도 나에겐 다른 세상 이야기라는 소외감을 뼈아프게 정부가 받아들여야 한다”며 “정책 전반에 걸쳐 청년에 더 많은 기회를 주기 위한 꾸준하고 세심한 노력이 중요하다”고 했다. 청년 세대의 민심 이반 현상이 심각하다고 보고 대책 마련을 촉구한 것이다.)

Among Blue House aides, a book titled "1020: The Far Right is Coming" by Jeong Min-cheol, a generational communicator who has studied the 20s and 30s demographic, is reportedly being shared as essential reading. The book argues for understanding the context behind the far-right turn among young people, rather than simply harboring aversion. This is interpreted as a move to focus on the background of the traditionally progressive-leaning youth shifting conservatism and reflect it in policy. (청와대 참모들 사이에서도 1020세대를 연구해온 정민철 세대 커뮤니케이터의 저서 ‘1020 극우가 온다’가 필독서로 공유되고 있다고 한다. 이 책은 극우화한 청년 세대를 혐오하기보다 그 맥락을 이해해야 한다는 내용을 담고 있다. 전통적으로 이념적 진보층에 속했던 청년 세대가 보수화한 배경에 주목해 이를 정책에 반영하자는 취지로 풀이된다.)

The Blue House plans to roll out effective youth policies backed by financial support. On the 2nd, President Lee instructed at a senior secretary meeting, "Please make the most of the anticipated additional tax revenue to ensure stable investment resources for future generations." Finance Planning Secretary Ryu Deok-hyun also stated in a YouTube interview on the 7th that the "Future Response Fund" would be allocated to youth policies. This signals an intent to use the record additional tax revenue from the semiconductor boom as a catalyst for youth initiatives. (청와대는 재정적 뒷받침을 통해 실효성 있는 청년 정책을 내놓겠단 구상이다. 이 대통령은 지난 2일 수석보좌관회의에서 “최근 예상되고 있는 추가 세수를 효율적으로 활용해 미래 세대를 위한 안정적인 투자 재원을 조성하는 데 만전을 기해달라”고 주문했다. 류덕현 재정기획보좌관도 지난 7일 유튜브 ‘청와대 팩트 방앗간’ 인터뷰에서 ‘미래대응기금’을 청년 정책 등에 투입하겠다고 밝혔다. 반도체 호황에 따른 역대급 추가 세수를 청년 정책의 마중물로 삼겠다는 뜻을 밝힌 것이다.)

The Democratic Party, ahead of its August 17 national convention, is also busy attending to youth concerns. (8·17 전당대회를 앞둔 더불어민주당에서도 청년 챙기기에 분주한 모습이다.)

On the 9th, the Democratic Party's convention preparation committee decided to revive the youth supreme council position after eight years and elect it separately. Party leadership contenders are also appealing to voters by championing a "youth-centered party." (민주당은 9일 전당대회준비위원회에서 8년 만에 청년최고위원직을 부활하고, 별도 선출하기로 의결했다. 당권 주자들도 ‘청년 중심 정당’을 앞세워 표심에 호소하고 있다.)

Lawmaker Song Young-gil, at a press conference on the 8th announcing his candidacy for party leader, said, "Without the support of the 30s and 40s generations, there will be no presidential election in 2030," and pledged to appoint two youth members as appointed supreme councilors. He proposed supplying 50,000 apartments for young people, newlyweds, and non-homeowners on the returned Yongsan U.S. military base and increasing the university dormitory occupancy rate to 50%. Lawmaker Ko Min-jung also stated, "We must stop using young people as accessories and place them at the center," suggesting a youth quota for party positions and the establishment of a youth future committee directly under the party leader. (송영길 의원은 지난 8일 당대표 출마 기자회견에서 “2030세대의 지지 없이 2030년 대선도 없다”며 지명직 최고위원 2명을 청년으로 임명하겠다고 했다. 그는 용산 미군 반환 부지에 청년·신혼부부·무주택자를 위한 아파트 5만호를 공급하고 대학기숙사 수용률을 50%로 상향하겠다고 했다. 고민정 의원도 “청년들을 더는 액세서리로 활용하지 말고 중심에 세워야 한다”며 청년 당직 할당제와 당대표 직속 청년 미래위원회 설치 등을 제시했다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, on the 6th, raised the slogan "2030 Democratic Party, Youth-Friendly Democratic Party" and announced plans to create a platform providing policy consulting for young people. Former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, who has yet to declare his candidacy, said on the 8th, "The employment and housing issues facing the 30s and 40s generations must be actively addressed by the party." (김민석 전 국무총리는 지난 6일 ‘2030 민주당, 청년 친화 민주당’을 화두로 내세우며 청년을 위한 정책 컨설팅을 제공하는 플랫폼을 만들겠다고 밝혔다. 아직 출마 선언 전인 정청래 전 대표는 지난 8일 “2030이 직면한 취업·주거 문제는 당에서 받아안아 적극 해결해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Sim Woo-sam Reporter wu32@hani.co.kr Ko Han-sol Reporter sol@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Yoon Suk Yeol sentenced to 7 years for obstruction of arrest... "People Power Party lawmakers who acted as 'human shields' must pay the price" (‘체포 방해’ 윤석열 징역 7년…“‘인간 방패’ 국힘 의원들 죗값 치러야”)
item.description:
On the 9th, as a seven-year prison term was finalized for former President Yoon Suk Yeol, who was put on trial for obstructing the execution of an arrest warrant by the Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials (CIO) in January last year, the political sphere responded that it was "a natural outcome of justice." There were also pointed remarks that People Power Party lawmakers suspected of participating in blocking the CIO's warrant execution "must pay a fitting price." <<> Boo Seung-chan, spokesperson for the Democratic Party of Korea, said in a written briefing that day, "This ruling is the Supreme Court's first verdict on Yoon Suk Yeol, who initiated the December 3 illegal martial law," and assessed, "It is significant in that the Supreme Court confirmed a guilty verdict for acts that privatized state power to obstruct legitimate warrant execution and investigation." <<> On that day, the Supreme Court's third division (presiding Justice Lee Sook-yeon) upheld the lower court's ruling sentencing Yoon to seven years in prison on charges including obstruction of special official duties and abuse of power hindering the exercise of rights. This is the first Supreme Court ruling among cases where Yoon was indicted in connection with the December 3 martial law, occurring 583 days after the declaration of martial law. <<> Spokesperson Boo, mentioning that Yoon is also facing an appeal trial for leading an insurrection among other cases, stated, "We hope for a strict judicial judgment befitting the public's desire for the complete eradication of insurrection and the restoration of constitutional order." <<> Son Sol, senior spokesperson for the Progressive Party, also said in a written briefing that day, "Compared to the crimes of trampling democracy and plotting insurrection, the sentence is far too lenient, but it is a stern judgment against a reckless power and an utterly natural result." <<> Criticism also arose regarding Yoon's legal team's announcement that they would challenge the constitutionality of this ruling through constitutional review procedures like a trial petition. Democratic Party lawmaker Park Joo-min wrote on Facebook that day, "It seems they still haven't come to their senses. They are already talking about a trial petition right after the Supreme Court's final ruling. At this point, it's not legal action but another provocation." item.title: Lee Je-hoon, former editor-in-chief of The Hankyoreh, appointed as head of the National Institute for Peaceful Unification, Democracy, and Education (평화통일민주교육원장에 이제훈 전 한겨레 편집국장)
item.description:
The Ministry of Unification announced on the 9th that it has appointed Lee Je-hoon, former editor-in-chief of The Hankyoreh, as the head of the National Institute for Peaceful Unification, Democracy, and Education. The term is two years. (통일부가 국립평화통일민주교육원장에 이제훈 전 한겨레 편집국장을 임용했다고 9일 밝혔다. 임기는 2년.)

The new director Lee is an expert in unification and diplomacy who began covering inter-Korean relations in 1998 when he first reported on the Ministry of Unification after joining The Hankyoreh in 1993. He earned his Ph.D. from the University of North Korean Studies in 2016 with a dissertation titled "Roh Tae-woo's Northern Policy and Asymmetric Post-Cold War," and is the author of works such as "Asymmetric Post-Cold War 1990-2020" (2023) and "Nuclear-Armed Joseon: Korea's Choice." (신임 이 원장은 1993년 한겨레에 입사해 1998년 통일부를 처음 출입하면서 남북관계 취재를 시작한 통일·외교 분야 전문가다. 2016년 북한대학원대학교에서 ‘노태우 정부의 북방정책과 비대칭적 탈냉전’을 주제로 박사학위를 받았고, 저서로 ‘비대칭 탈냉전 1990-2020’(2023), ‘핵무장 조선, 한국의 선택은’ 등이 있다.)

item.title: North Korean Premier Pak Tae-song to Lead Delegation on Official Visit to China from 10th to 12th (박태성 북한 총리, 대표단 이끌고 10∼12일 중국 공식 방문)
item.description:
A North Korean delegation will pay an official visit to China on the 10th, marking the 65th anniversary of the signing of the Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance between North Korea and China (North Korea-China Friendship Treaty). (북한 대표단이 북중 우호협력 상호 원조조약(북중 우호조약) 체결 65주년을 맞아 10일 중국을 공식 방문한다.)

The Korean Central News Agency reported on the 9th that a delegation led by Premier Pak Tae-song, representing the Workers' Party of Korea and the North Korean government, will officially visit China to attend events commemorating the 65th anniversary of the treaty on friendship, cooperation, and mutual assistance. The news agency said the visit was made at the invitation of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese government. China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs also confirmed on the same day that Premier Pak will lead a party and government delegation on an official visit to China from the 10th to the 12th. (조선중앙통신은 박태성 내각총리를 단장으로 조선노동당과 북한 정부 대표단이 중국을 공식 방문해 조중(북중) 우호·협조 및 상호원조에 관한 조약 체결 65돌 기념행사에 참가할 것이라고 9일 보도했다. 이번 방문은 중국공산당 중앙위원회와 중국 정부 초청에 의한 것이라고 통신은 전했다. 중국 외교부도 이날 박 총리가 10∼12일 당정 대표단을 이끌고 중국을 공식 방문한다고 확인했다.)

Since this year marks the 65th anniversary of the North Korea-China Friendship Treaty, which falls on a significant milestone every 5 to 10 years, the commemoration is expected to be held on a larger scale. Chinese President Xi Jinping, during a summit with North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un in Pyongyang last month, emphasized the need to hold a grand celebration to mark the signing of the treaty. This event could pave the way for high-level exchanges and economic cooperation promised during the summit to materialize. Attention is particularly focused on whether discussions will occur regarding the full reopening of border trade passages or the opening of the New Yalu River Bridge. (올해 북중 우호조약 체결 65주년 기념일은 5·10년 주기로 꺾이는 정주년 행사이기 때문에, 보다 큰 규모로 행사가 치러질 것으로 보인다. 시진핑 중국 국가주석은 지난달 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 평양에서 한 정상회담에서 북중 우호조약 체결을 기념한 행사를 성대하게 열어야 한다고 강조했다. 이 행사를 계기로 북-중이 정상회담에서 약속한 고위급 교류와 경제협력이 가시화할 가능성도 있다. 특히 국경 통상구 전면 재개통이나 신압록강대교 개통 관련 논의가 이뤄질지 주목된다.)

At the time of the 60th anniversary commemoration in 2021, North Korea had sealed its borders due to COVID-19, preventing in-person exchanges. However, Chairman Xi and Chairman Kim exchanged congratulatory messages to solidify their friendship and cooperation. (2021년 60주년 체결 기념일 당시엔 코로나19로 북한이 국경을 봉쇄해 대면 교류를 하지 못했다. 다만 시 주석과 김 위원장이 축전을 교환하며 우호·협력 관계를 다졌다.)

Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning, during a regular briefing, stated regarding the background of Premier Pak's visit to China that "both sides have agreed to jointly hold grand commemorative events" and that "maintaining, consolidating, and developing China-North Korea relations is a consistent and firm strategy of the Chinese Communist Party and government." She added, "China hopes to work with North Korea, guided by the important common understandings of the top leaders of both parties and countries, to strengthen strategic communication," and "we look forward to closely conducting exchanges and cooperation to continuously promote the development of the traditional China-North Korea friendly and cooperative relations." (마오닝 중국 외교부 대변인은 정례브리핑에서 박 총리의 방중 배경과 관련해 “양측은 공동으로 성대한 기념행사를 개최하기로 합의했다”며 “중조(중국과 북한) 관계를 잘 유지하고 공고히 하며 발전시키는 것은 중국 공산당과 정부의 일관되고 확고한 전략”이라고 말했다. 이어 “중국은 북한과 함께 양당·양국 최고지도자들의 중요한 공동인식을 지침으로 삼아 전략적 소통을 강화하길 원한다”며 “교류와 협력을 긴밀히 해 전통적 중조 우호협력 관계가 끊임없이 발전하도록 추진해 나가기를 희망한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hong Myung-bo and Chung Mong-gyu Named as Witnesses for National Assembly’s Football Association Hearing… Will the People Power Party Participate? (홍명보·정몽규, 국회 ‘축협 청문회’ 증인으로…국힘 참여할까)
item.description:
The National Assembly’s Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee will hold a hearing on the Korea Football Association on the 22nd at 10 a.m. Witnesses include former national football team head coach Hong Myung-bo and former Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu, while references include Park Ji-sung, co-chair of the K-Football Innovation Committee, and national football player Son Heung-min (LAFC). (국회 문화체육관광위원회가 오는 22일 오전 10시 대한축구협회에 대한 청문회를 개최한다. 증인에는 홍명보 전 축구 국가대표팀 감독, 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장 등이, 참고인에는 박지성 케이(K)-축구 혁신위원회 공동위원장과 국가대표 축구선수 손흥민(LAFC) 등이 이름을 올렸다.)

On the 9th, the committee held a plenary session and adopted a plan for the hearing on pending issues related to the Korea Football Association, led by the Democratic Party of Korea. In addition to former Coach Hong and former President Chung, witnesses include Lee Im-saeng, former technical director of the Korea Football Association, who played a key role in appointing Hong. Along with Chairman Park and Son Heung-min, co-chair of the K-Football Innovation Committee Yoo Seung-min, K-Football Innovation Committee members Lee Young-pyo and Park Joo-ho, and football player Hwang Hee-chan (Wolverhampton) have been confirmed as references. (문체위는 9일 전체회의를 열어 대한축구협회 현안 관련 청문회 실시계획서를 더불어민주당 주도로 채택했다. 증인에는 홍 전 감독과 정 전 회장 외에도 홍 전 감독 선임 당시 주도적 역할을 했던 이임생 전 축구협회 기술총괄이사 등이 포함됐다. 박 위원장, 손흥민과 함께 유승민 케이-축구 혁신위 공동위원장, 이영표·박주호 케이-축구 혁신위원, 축구선수 황희찬(울버햄프턴) 등은 참고인으로 확정됐다.)

However, it remains uncertain whether all of them will attend the hearing. Former Coach Hong, who sparked a ‘flight controversy’ by leaving for the United States just two days after returning from the 2026 North and Central America World Cup elimination, released a statement indicating his intention to attend. Hong stated, “If a hearing is held, it will be a place to explain the World Cup results to the public. As a coach, I will bear all the responsibility I must shoulder alone to the end.” He added, “I will tell the public the facts as I know them and will avoid no questions.” (다만 이들이 모두 청문회에 출석할지는 미지수다. 2026 북중미 월드컵에서 탈락해 귀국한 지 이틀 만에 미국으로 다시 출국하면서 ‘도피 논란’이 일었던 홍 전 감독은 이날 입장문을 내어 출석 의사를 밝혔다. 홍 전 감독은 “청문회가 열린다면 그 자리는 월드컵 결과에 대해 국민 여러분께 설명드리는 자리”라며 “감독으로서 제가 감당해야 할 책임 역시 저 혼자 끝까지 감당하겠다”고 했다. 그러면서 “국민 여러분 앞에서 제가 알고 있는 사실을 있는 그대로 말씀드리며, 어떠한 질문도 피하지 않겠다”고 했다.)

The hearing is expected to address ongoing controversies, including the appointment process of former Coach Jürgen Klinsmann and Coach Hong, as well as suspicions of the association’s arbitrary management. Democratic Party Secretary Rep. Lee Jung-moon said, “The committee will lead reforms to restore fairness and trust in sports administration overall.” (청문회에서는 그동안 논란이 이어져온 위르겐 클린스만 전 감독과 홍 전 감독 선임 과정, 협회의 독단적 운영 의혹 등이 다뤄질 것으로 예상된다. 민주당 간사인 이정문 의원은 “체육 행정 전반의 공정성과 신뢰를 바로 세우도록 문체위가 중심이 돼 개혁을 이끌겠다”고 말했다.)

All lawmakers from the People Power Party were absent from the plenary session that day. The party is boycotting all National Assembly schedules in protest of the composition of the Assembly. (이날 전체회의에는 국민의힘 의원들이 전원 불참했다. 국민의힘은 국회 원 구성에 항의하며 국회 일정을 전면 거부하고 있다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)
